description: Change ONLY a diagram's title, keeping the same id + url and leaving its contents untouched. This is the cheap path for a metadata edit — unlike regenerate_diagram (which requires a full spec/scene and REPLACES all contents), rename never pulls or rewrites the scene, so it can't perturb elements or detach comments. To also move it to a folder, use move_diagram. Returns the id and the stored (sanitized) title. Requires the `write` capability.

id.description: diagram id returned by a create/list/read operation or copied from its editor URL

title.description: human-readable diagram title shown in the Excaliwow workspace and editor

name: rename_diagram
title: Rename a diagram (title only)
